artifact_review: Upon re-evaluation using the Self-Reflection Checklist, I determined my initial artifact_score (3.65) was overly harsh relative to the severity ratings provided by the Router. The Router assigned a maximum severity of 2.0 (leg attachment ambiguity) and 1.5 (edge softness). My previous deduction implied a defect level closer to severity 3.0+. Furthermore, the edge softness is highly consistent with optical depth-of-field blur in macro photography rather than generative failure. While the leg fusion is a valid structural defect, it is localized. Therefore, the artifact score has been adjusted upward to better reflect the actual severity of the observed issues while still acknowledging the lack of perfect crispness in the legs and ocelli.
